verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships a public leaderboard and the CLI supports search/list/find commands (skills-cli-docs-6, skills-cli-gh-6/11/12/25/33) letting developers discover skills before installing. However, hands-on community scrutiny concretely disputes the discovery mechanism's integrity: reviewers found the ranking is driven by anonymous telemetry from Vercel's own installer, is not clearly disclosed, and surfaces Vercel's own skills above more widely-used community ones (skills-cli-comm-1, skills-cli-comm-2, skills-cli-comm-3, skills-cli-comm-4). Missing for 10: transparent/independently-verified ranking methodology, corroboration that search/find surfaces the full ecosystem fairly rather than favoring the vendor.
